item.title: 米国株式市場＝ナスダック・Ｓ＆Ｐ反落、エヌビディア主導の上昇一服
item.description: ［２４日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はナスダック総合とＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種が反落して取引を終えた。前日に急伸したエヌビデ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ナスダック・Ｓ＆Ｐ反落、エヌビディア主導の上昇一服 6:35 配信

米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で11月24日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） ［２４日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はナスダック総合とＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種が反落して取引を終えた。前日に急伸したエヌビディアなど人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株に売りが出たほか、新たな関税導入の可能性に警戒感が広がった。

エヌビディアは５．９％安。前日にジェンスン・フアン氏が最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に復帰したことを巡り、政治面や企業統治上のリスクが問われる中、市場は復帰の影響を見極めようとしている。

Ｓ＆Ｐ情報技術指数が２．８％安で業種別の下げを主導し、フィラデルフィア半導体指数は７．９％安となった。

先週上場したＡＩ開発企業アンソロピックは６．５％安の８１．９０ドルで取引を終え、公開価格の８３ドルを下回った。

一方、関係筋によると、トランプ米政権は主要貿易相手国１６カ国・地域における過剰な産業生産能力への対抗を目的とした調査の結果を近く公表する見通し。幅広い品目を対象に新たな輸入関税が課される見込みという。

セテラ・フィナンシャル・グループのジーン・ゴールドマン最高投資責任者は「数カ月ぶりの大幅な上昇の後だけに、ある程度の利益確定売りは予想された。結局のところ、一つのニュースだけで人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資に対する投資家の疑問が解消するわけではない」と述べた。また、追加関税は市場の不確実性を高めるほか、２５日発表の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）統計を前に投資家が慎重になっているとも指摘した。

ＣＭＥグループのフェドウオッチによると、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１２月に２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施するとの見方が大勢となっている。

米民間調査機関コンファレンス・ボード（ＣＢ）が発表した１１月の消費者信頼感指数は約２年ぶりの水準に上昇。今月の中間選挙を受け、労働市場や景気全般に対する楽観的な見方が広がった。

小売株は買われ、利益見通しを引き上げたアバクロンビー・アンド・フィッチが１９．７％急伸。同じく利益見通しを引き上げたダラー・ツリーも１１．２％上昇した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．０４対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０７対１で値下がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は１８８億９０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は約１９５億株。

item.title: China's Huawei convicted in sprawling US criminal trial over Iran business
item.description: A Brooklyn federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts over deceiving banks about Iran business and stealing US companies’ trade secrets.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

China's Huawei convicted in sprawling US criminal trial over Iran business

A Brooklyn federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts over deceiving banks about Iran business and stealing US companies’ trade secrets.

A view shows a Huawei logo at Huawei Technologies France headquarters in Boulogne-Billancourt near Paris, France, Jan 9, 2025. (Photo: REUTERS/Gonzalo)

25 Nov 2026 05:33AM (Updated: 25 Nov 2026 10:24AM)

FAST

NEW YORK: Chinese telecommunications equipment maker Huawei was convicted by a jury in New York City on Tuesday (Nov 25) in a sprawling US criminal case on charges that it deceived banks about its business in Iran and stole trade secrets from American companies. The verdict came in a criminal case that began in 2018, with the US government the following year placing Huawei on a trade blacklist that restricted its access to US technology amid American concerns that Huawei posed national security risks. The jury in Brooklyn federal court found Huawei guilty on 10 of the 12 criminal counts the company faced, including bank fraud, wire fraud, sanctions violations and conspiring to steal trade secrets. The jury acquitted Huawei of conspiring to obstruct justice and racketeering conspiracy, a charge alleging the company had acted as a criminal enterprise. The trial lasted more than two months, with prosecutors calling more than 60 witnesses and the defense calling 15. It was not immediately clear what penalties Huawei will face when US District Judge Ann Donnelly sentences it on Sep 14, 2027.

Reuters stories in 2012 and 2013 helped expose Huawei's activities in Iran and were discussed during the trial. "After the media started questioning Huawei's operations in Iran, so did Huawei's banks," prosecutor Meredith Arfa told jurors during closing arguments in the case last week. Brian Heberlig, a lawyer for Huawei, said the company was disappointed by the convictions but said the acquittal on the racketeering conspiracy charge vindicated its "good-faith compliance culture." "We fully expect to appeal," Heberlig told reporters. US Attorney Joseph Nocella said in a statement: “Few crimes are as serious as Huawei’s decades-long pattern of endangering US national security, violating the sanctity of US commerce, and impeding the enforcement of US laws.” China's embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Related:

Racketeering conspiracy trial against Chinese tech giant Huawei begins in New York

US plans to ban Chinese telecom firms from direct access to US phone numbers

Asked how much the company may have to pay in penalties, Heberlig said it was premature to comment, but said the acquittal on the racketeering conspiracy charge could make a significant difference. Experts have said the case did not undermine Huawei's business, as the company diversified and emerged as a key player in China's push for artificial intelligence. FOUNDER'S DAUGHTER WAS DETAINED In December 2018, Meng Wanzhou, Huawei's chief financial officer and daughter of the company's founder, was detained in Canada on a US warrant, prompting a diplomatic crisis involving the United States, China and Canada. Meng had been secretly indicted on US charges of misleading an HSBC banker about Huawei's business in Iran, so the company could move dollars in and out of Iran in violation of American sanctions. Meng fought extradition to the US for nearly three years, before entering a deferred prosecution agreement and flying home to China to a hero's welcome. The charges against her were dropped. Meng did not testify at trial, though an HSBC banker she met with in 2013 did testify.

Defence lawyer Brian Heberlig makes closing arguments at the Huawei Technologies trial before US District Judge Ann M. Donnelly at Brooklyn Federal Court in New York City, US, Nov 17, 2026 in this courtroom sketch. (Photo: REUTERS/Jane Rosenberg)

The 2018 indictment alleged that Huawei misled HSBC, Standard Chartered and BNP Paribas about its business dealings in Iran. Prosecutors added new charges in 2020, including allegations that Huawei conspired to steal trade secrets from US technology companies over two decades. THE PROSECUTION CASE During the trial, prosecutors sought to prove that Huawei stole source code from Cisco Systems for its routers, stole wireless telecommunications company Quintel's antenna technology, and hired a professor to gain access to a circuit board developed by semiconductor company CNEX. Jurors watched a video that, according to prosecutors, showed a Huawei employee slipping a piece of a T-Mobile testing robot into his backpack, and heard about a Huawei engineer sneaking into a Fujitsu booth at a trade show to photograph a device. Prosecutors gave jurors a statement attached to Meng's deferred prosecution agreement in which she acknowledged that the company illegally conducted business in Iran. The defense argued that HSBC and the other banks knew about Huawei's business in Iran and were competing for Huawei's business. Heberlig accused prosecutors during his closing argument of having "cherry-picked" a handful of disparate incidents to support their claim of a 20-year conspiracy. Heberlig said Huawei succeeded through "hard work, innovation, and investment in research and development". The company has more than 200,000 employees and operates in approximately 170 countries.

Source: Reuters/fs/lk

item.title: 中国ファーウェイに有罪評決、イラン事業や営業秘密窃取巡る米訴訟
item.description:
Karen Freifeld
[ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の通信機器大手、華為技術（ファーウェイ）は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国ファーウェイに有罪評決、イラン事業や営業秘密窃取巡る米訴訟 6:09 配信

２０２１年２月撮影　REUTERS/Gonzalo Fuentes（ロイター） Karen Freifeld

[ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター] -  中国の通信機器大手、華為技術（ファーウェイ）は２４日、イラン事業を巡って銀行を欺いたことや、米企業から営業秘密を盗んだことなどに関する米国の大規模な刑事訴訟で有罪評決を受けた。

ニューヨーク市ブルックリンの連邦地裁の陪審は、ファーウェイに対する１２件の訴因のうち１０件で有罪と判断。同社が犯罪組織として活動したとする組織犯罪共謀罪については無罪とした。

ファーウェイは声明で、有罪評決を受けた訴因について「法的根拠を欠いている」と主張。「自社の権利と利益を守るため、必要なあらゆる法的措置を講じる」とした。

米当局は長年にわたり、ファーウェイが国家安全保障上のリスクをもたらしていると主張し、同社を追及。今回の刑事事件は２０１８年に開始され、ファーウェイと関連会社３社は組織犯罪共謀、銀行詐欺、通信詐欺、制裁違反、営業秘密窃取共謀、司法妨害共謀など計１２件の罪に問われていた。

１８年の起訴状によると、ファーウェイはイランでの事業取引を巡り、英金融大手ＨＳＢＣ、スタンダード・チャータード銀行、仏ＢＮＰパリバに対し誤解を与える説明を行った罪があるとされていた。検察は２０年に起訴内容を拡大し、ファーウェイが約２０年間にわたり米テクノロジー企業から営業秘密を窃取する共謀を行ったとの訴因を追加した。

検察側は公判で、ファーウェイが米ネットワーク機器大手シスコ・システムズのルーター向けソースコードを盗用したほか、無線通信企業クインテルのアンテナ技術を不正に取得し、半導体企業ＣＮＥＸが開発した回路基板へのアクセスを得るため大学教授を利用したことを立証しようとした。

弁護側は、ＨＳＢＣやその他の銀行はファーウェイのイラン事業について把握しており、むしろファーウェイとの取引獲得を巡って競争していたと主張。ファーウェイ側の弁護士ブライアン・ヘバーリグ氏は最終弁論で、検察が約２０年にわたる共謀の存在を立証するため、「互いに関連性の乏しい少数の事例だけを恣意的に取り上げた」と述べた。

ファーウェイは２０万人超の従業員を擁し、約１７０カ国・地域で事業を展開。米政府はファーウェイが国家安全保障上の脅威になるとの懸念から１９年に同社を輸出規制対象のブラックリストに追加し、米国技術へのアクセスを制限している。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：交渉か軍事行動拡大か、トランプ氏が直面する対イラン選択肢 コラム：石油価格、イラン攻撃による急騰から持久戦へ コラム：学校配布端末は本当に安全か、米国で広がる「反エドテック」訴訟の波 コラム：ＡＩ利用の本人訴訟、米国で増加　便利さの裏に潜む「ハルシネーション」の罠 アングル：トランプ関税が生んだ新潮流、中国企業がベトナム展開加速 11/25(水) 6:16 最終更新 ロイター

item.description: Nov 24 : Dell Technologies on Tuesday raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year after record quarterly results, fueled by soaring enterprise demand for AI infrastructure.Shares of Dell were up about 5 per cent in extended trading after the company's board also approved an add

Dell lifts annual forecasts after record quarter on surging AI server demand

The logo of Dell Technologies at the Milipol Paris in Villepinte near Paris, France, November 15, 2023. REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

FAST

Nov 24 : Dell Technologies on Tuesday raised its annual revenue and profit forecasts for the third time this year after record quarterly results, fueled by soaring enterprise demand for AI infrastructure. Shares of Dell were up about 5 per cent in extended trading after the company's board also approved an additional $25 billion share repurchase plan. The Texas-based company has been benefiting from the generative AI boom, as more businesses and cloud providers are buying Dell's AI servers, which are powered by Nvidia chips, to run complex AI workloads and autonomous agents. For fiscal 2027, Dell now expects revenue of $202 billion, above its prior target of $192 billion and Wall Street expectations of $194.48 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.

The company also raised its annual AI-optimized server revenue forecast to $78 billion from $74 billion and its adjusted earnings per share estimate to $29.68 from $25.50. Rival PC maker HP on Tuesday reported fourth-quarter revenue of $16 billion, beating analysts' average estimate of $15.42 billion, driven by AI-powered device shipments and commercial PC demand. Dell, meanwhile, reported slower growth in its PC business as customers prioritized spending on servers and storage. Its PC unit revenue rose 3 per cent to $12.89 billion in the third quarter ended October 30, compared with 20 per cent growth in the previous three months. Both Dell and HP warned of continued memory cost pressures, with Dell expecting the memory chip shortage to continue into 2027. Dell's Infrastructure Solutions Group, which houses its server and storage operations, largely drove the gains in the company's profit and growth, with revenue from the segment nearly tripling to $41.97 billion in the third quarter. Enterprises are "buying more compute to accommodate growing workloads, refreshing their installed base and modernizing their data centers to free up power and space to be positioned for the AI era," said Jeff Clarke, Dell's chief operating officer. Dell's record third-quarter revenue of $54.94 billion exceeded analysts' average estimate of $49.32 billion. Its adjusted EPS of $9.45 also topped estimates of $6.59. Clarke said demand continues to accelerate and broaden globally, with more than 7,500 customers deploying Dell AI Factories, a bundle that combines servers, storage, networking and software to help businesses build and run AI models. Dell ended the third quarter with a record $132.3 billion in AI server backlog after logging $60.2 billion in new orders during the period.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 原油先物2ドル超高、ホルムズ海峡で新たな船舶攻撃 供給途絶を警戒
item.description:
Georgina McCartney
[ヒューストン ２４日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は乱高下した後、２ドル...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物2ドル超高、ホルムズ海峡で新たな船舶攻撃　供給途絶を警戒 5:42 配信

フランス・マルセイユ近郊の石油拠点フォスシュルメール付近を航行する石油タンカー。10月17日撮影。REUTERS/Manon Cruz（ロイター） Georgina McCartney

[ヒューストン ２４日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は乱高下した後、２ドル超上昇して取引を終えた。ホルムズ海峡とその周辺で船舶に対する新たな攻撃が報告されたことが材料となった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が２．０３ドル（２．２７％）高の１バレル＝９１．４０ドル。取引時間中に一時、８月２７日以来の安値を付けたものの、そこから反発した。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．８８ドル（２．３５％）高の８２．０５ドル。取引時間中に、８月１０日以来の安値を付けた。

ブレントは取引時間中に８８．１０ドルまで下落し、ＷＴＩも株式相場の下落に押されて７９．０７ドルまで値を下げる場面があった。

イラン国営メディアによると、イスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）は、ホルムズ海峡付近で「無許可の」航路を航行していたコンテナ船が攻撃を受けたと発表した。英海事貿易機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は２４日、２３日にホルムズ海峡を東に向けて航行していた船舶３隻が、正体不明の飛翔体により攻撃を受けたと発表した。ＵＫＭＴＯによると、３隻はいずれも航行を続けており、乗組員も全員無事だという。

コンサルティング会社ゲルバー・アンド・アソシエーツのアナリストはリポートで「供給過剰の見通しが相場の回復を抑制し続けており、さらなる攻撃が実際に供給を遮断するかどうかによって原油相場が左右される状況が続いている」と指摘した。

Nov 24 : Artificial intelligence consumes less water per dollar spent than almond milk or golf, according to a new study from Enverus Intelligence Research. The report puts $25 a month of AI spending at about 1.9 gallons of water consumption, including water used to generate the electricity that powers data centers. • According to the report, $25 spent on almond milk consumes 308 gallons of water, while the same amount spent on golf course green fees consumes 679 gallons • Household electricity on an all-natural-gas grid consumes about 31 gallons for the same spending, says the report

item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルがユーロなどの主要通貨に対し軟調に推移した。前日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、ＡＩ株急騰一服　上昇ペースに警戒も 5:32 配信

２００８年3月撮影　REUTERS/Mark Blinch（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルがユーロなどの主要通貨に対し軟調に推移した。前日は米半導体大手エヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）にジェンスン・フアン氏が復帰したことで米株式市場でＡＩ（人工知能）関連株が急伸。この日は勢いが一服したことに加え、ドルは短期間で過度に上昇したのではないかとの見方が広がったことが相場の重しになった。

ドルは、米経済成長が堅調でインフレ率も米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の目標である２％をなお上回っていることから、ＦＲＢが利上げを継続するとの観測にも支えられてきた。ただ、ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者エリアス・ハダド氏は「１１月はユーロ圏、英国、日本に対する米国の成長優位性がさらに縮小した」とし、こうした動きがドルの重しになる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ＣＭＥフェドウォッチによると、１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げが決定される確率は９７％。来年１月２６─２７日のＦＯＭＣでも利上げが決定される確率は６６％と織り込まれている。

この日発表の米経済指標では、米民間調査機関コンファレンス・ボード（ＣＢ）発表の１１月の消費者信頼感指数が１０３．３と、２０２５年１月以来、約２年ぶりの高水準。今月の中間選挙を受けて、労働市場や景気全般に対する楽観的な見方が広がった。

終盤の取引で主要通貨に対するドル指数 は０．４７％安の１０３．８１。

円は対ドルで０．１６％安の１５９．２４円。

ユーロ／ドルは０．６％高の１．０９６６ドル。 独ＩＦＯ経済研究所が２４日発表した１１月の業況指数は９０．６と、１０月の改定値９０．１から上昇。上昇は７カ月連続で、第４・四半期の景気回復を示す材料となった。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）ではビットコインが２．４０％安の５万９８２４ドル。

SAO PAULO, Nov 24 : When a tiny blue chick finally broke free from its shell after weeks of anxious waiting, keepers at Brazil's Sao Paulo Zoo saw more than the birth of a bird; they saw a glimmer of hope for a species that has vanished from the wild. Aptly named Hope, the female Spix's macaw born in October forms part of a breeding program aimed at rebuilding populations of one of the world's rarest parrots. Known in Brazil as the Ararinha-azul, the species became internationally famous after inspiring Blu, the main character of the 2011 animated film Rio, a domesticated Spix's macaw who embarks on a journey to save his species. "We chose 'Hope' because we hope we can give a better future to this species," said Fernanda Guida, head biologist at the zoo's bird division.

Hope's arrival followed a tense 28-day artificial incubation process. Zoo specialists removed the egg for monitoring and eventually intervened when the bird struggled to hatch. Brazil's environment ministry backs the zoo's program. "It was 28 days of suffering until we saw her hatch. She needed help, we had to remove her from inside the egg because she was badly positioned, and then she hatched," Guida said. Native to the Caatinga region of northeastern Brazil, Spix's macaws were pushed to the brink of extinction by deforestation and decades of trapping for the illegal pet trade. The species is classified as "extinct in the wild" by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) Red List, meaning its survival has depended on captive populations. "That first hatching was a very important milestone for the conservation of the Spix's macaw," Guida said. "It's a long road ahead of us, but it's the path we hope will be very successful."

item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（24日） 4:47 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。鉱業や銀行株の売り注文が優勢で、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に下落。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．８４％安だった。

金や銅の値下がりを受けて、資源大手グレンコアは４．８％、アングロ・アメリカンは５．７％、銅大手アントファガスタは８．１％、いずれも下落。

銀行大手のバークレイズは２．５％、ＨＳＢＣは２．７％、スタンダード・チャータードは２．８％、いずれも値下がりした。

一方、日用品のユニリーバは２．０％高。製薬大手ＧＳＫは２．５％、アストラゼネカは２．９％、それぞれ上昇した。

ケータリングサービス大手コンパスは２０２６年９月期決算の売上高が市場予想を上回り、４．２％上昇。オンライン家電販売のＡＯワールドは、需要低迷への懸念から９．３％安。

２５日発表の米個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）統計の発表に関心が集まる。市場では、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）による１２月に２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げ決定が確実視されている。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は１２月会合で利上げするとの見方が強い。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。前日大幅上昇したハイテク株が人工知能（ＡＩ）関連や企業統治を巡る懸念から反落し、相場の重荷となった。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は２．８１％安。

ＵＢＳが投資判断を引き下げたドイツの半導体製造装置メーカー、アイクストロンは１６．３％安。ドイツの半導体大手インフィニオン・テクノロジーズは９．７％、オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭインターナショナルは８．０％、それぞれ下落した。

金や銅の値下がりを受けて、資源株指数は４．６４％安。

一方、ヘルスケア株指数は１．８９％高。フランスの製薬大手サノフィは９．８％上昇。同業の米インスメッドを４１０億ドルで買収すると発表したことが好感された。

食品・飲料株指数は１．１６％、個人・家庭用品株指数は０．８６％、それぞれ上昇した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが小幅低下した。株式市場が反落し、原油先物価格が約３カ月ぶりの安値圏で推移する中、安全資産への資金流入が幾分下支えとなった。

欧州株と米国株は２３日の大幅上昇から一転、２４日に反落し、一部の資金が債券に向かった。また、北海ブレント先物は、取引序盤に付けた３カ月ぶりの安値から反発、欧州のガス価格も小幅上昇した。

市場はＥＣＢの１２月理事会での利上げをほぼ確実視しており、来年前半に追加利上げが１回実施されるとの見方を織り込んでいる。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の３．２７％。

ＥＣＢの政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは小幅低下の３．０７％。

フランス１０年債利回りは３ｂｐ低下の４．７６％。独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４８ｂｐと、１０月中旬に付けた１７０ｂｐ超の高水準から縮小した。

イタリア１０年債利回りは４．３５％と小幅に上昇した。

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 24 : The US Central Intelligence Agency and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence recently discovered a cybersecurity breach that exposed some of their unclassified information, according to a person familiar with the matter. The intrusions affected a network that looks for intelligence insights in public, unclassified material, according to the New York Times, which first reported on the breach. While it was not clear specifically what unclassified material was compromised, information at other government agencies was also believed to have been exposed in the breach, the Times added. Asked about the report, the ODNI said there had been "no disruptions to critical capabilities or classified systems." The news is the latest in a series of tech outages and cybersecurity incidents, including a breach reported at the US Department of Agriculture. Two separate breaches have recently been disclosed at the FBI, while the Pentagon and the Department of Homeland Security have also been caught up in recent cyber incidents. The Times report did not say how the breach occurred.

Source: Reuters

item.description: [２４日 ロイター] - ＪＰモルガンは２４日、米宇宙企業スペースＸについて、電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラ＜TSLA....
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
スペースＸ、テスラと合併実現ならＳ＆Ｐ５００採用後押し＝ＪＰモルガン 3:49 配信

6月11日作成。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） [２４日 ロイター] - ＪＰモルガンは２４日、米宇宙企業スペースＸについて、電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラ＜TSLA.O＞との合併が実現すれば、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種への組み入れを後押しする可能性があるとの見方を示した。

英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）によると、米実業家イーロン・マスク氏率いるテスラとスペースＸは、合併交渉を担う２つの特別委員会を主導する取締役として、テスラから３人、スペースＸから２人の計５人を選任した。

スペースＸは現在、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００構成銘柄への採用要件を満たしていない。しかし、過去の事例を踏まえると、テスラとの合併が成立した場合、Ｓ＆Ｐダウ・ジョーンズ委員会が一部要件を免除する可能性があると、ＪＰモルガンのアナリストらは指摘した。

さらに、スペースＸ株のロックアップ（既存株主による売却制限）解除に伴い、Ｓ＆Ｐは浮動株調整ベースでの同社時価総額を見直す見通しで、これによってＳ＆Ｐのより広範な株価指数への組み入れ時期が早まる可能性があるという。

ＪＰモルガンはまた、スペースＸが株価指数に組み入れられれば、浮動株の約１０％に相当するパッシブ運用による買いを誘発する可能性があるとの見方を示した。

FAST

Nov 24 : Elon Musk asked a federal appeals court to overturn a jury verdict finding he defrauded Twitter shareholders out of billions of dollars by threatening to abandon his purchase of the social media company four years ago. In a court filing on Monday night, Musk said shareholders failed to prove that Twitter's stock price fell on May 13, 2022, because he posted that the $44 billion takeover was "temporarily on hold" until Twitter demonstrated that its platform was not overrun by fake and spam accounts. Musk told the San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals that nothing linked the 9.7 per cent share price decline to $40.72 to any "material falsity" in his post, and that shareholders sought to hold him liable for securities fraud simply because the share price fell. The world's richest person also said the trial judge should not have certified a class action because many investors likely did not rely on his post when selling Twitter shares.

Lawyers for the shareholders did not immediately respond to requests for comment on Tuesday. One of the lawyers has said Musk might owe $2.6 billion plus interest if the verdict stands. Class actions let plaintiffs sue as a group, potentially leading to greater damages at lower cost than in individual lawsuits. Shareholders accused Musk of expressing concern about fake and spam accounts to back out of the takeover or force Twitter to renegotiate a lower price. They said Twitter's share price remained depressed until Musk agreed in October 2022 to complete his original $54.20 per share offer. In upholding the verdict in July, US District Judge Charles Breyer in San Francisco found "substantial evidence of falsity" in Musk's May 13 tweet, and said qualms about completing a transaction "do not justify lying to the investing public." Musk changed Twitter's name to X, and later folded it into his rocket and satellite company SpaceX.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ベストバイ、通期売上高見通し上げ 年末商戦の需要に期待
item.description:
Juveria Tabassum
[２４日 ロイター] - 米家電量販大手ベストバイは２４日、通期の既存店売上高伸び率...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ベストバイ、通期売上高見通し上げ　年末商戦の需要に期待 2:22 配信

2025年2月11日に撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration（ロイター） Juveria Tabassum

[２４日 ロイター] - 米家電量販大手ベストバイは２４日、通期の既存店売上高伸び率見通しを引き上げた。消費者が人工知能（ＡＩ）搭載の新型携帯電話やテレビ、スマートグラスなどのウエアラブル端末に支出する中、年末商戦の堅調な需要を見込む。

通期の既存店売上高伸び率を３．４─４％と予想。従来見通しの１．９─３％から引き上げた。株価は午前の取引で２％超上昇した。

第３・四半期の売上高は５．８％増の１０２億４０００万ドル。ＬＳＥＧがまとめた予想の９９億ドルを上回った。同四半期の調整後１株利益は１．６２ドルと予想を上回った。同社は２７年度の調整後１株利益見通しを６．９０─７．０５ドルに引き上げた。

ジェーソン・ボンフィグ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）によると、テイクツー・インタラクティブの看板ゲームシリーズの待望の新作「グランド・セフト・オートＶＩ」の発売に備える顧客の需要を受け、第３・四半期はゲーム機本体や周辺機器の販売が伸びた。また、「健康管理用リング、ＡＩグラス、トレーディングカードや収集品といった新興カテゴリーが、既存店売上高の伸び率を約１ポイント押し上げている」とした。

幹部は決算説明会で、メモリー半導体のコスト上昇が製品価格を押し上げたものの、パソコン関連の需要は底堅さを維持したと説明した。

同四半期は１５００ドルを超える価格帯の販売が「非常に好調」だった。既存店売上高全体は６．１％増と、予想の２．３％増を大きく上回った。

今月初めにＣＥＯに就任したボンフィグ氏は、燃料費上昇の影響を和らげるため、サプライチェーン内で対応を進めていると述べた。

スティーフルのアナリスト、マイケル・モンタニ氏は、パソコン関連製品と携帯電話がけん引する既存店売上高の伸びは、年末商戦を控えたウォルマート、ターゲット、コストコなど他の小売大手の家電販売にとっても明るい兆候だと指摘した。

item.title: 中国シャオミ7─9月期、自動車市場低迷で57％減益 独への参入計画表明
item.description:
Ju-min Park
[北京 ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）・スマートフォンメーカー、小米（シャ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国シャオミ7─9月期、自動車市場低迷で57％減益　独への参入計画表明 2:20 配信

写真は中国シャオミのロゴ。2024年4月25日、北京で開催された「北京国際自動車展」で撮影。（ロイター） Ju-min Park

[北京 ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の電気自動車（ＥＶ）・スマートフォンメーカー、小米（シャオミ）が２４日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７─９月期）決算は、総売上高が前年同期比５．２％減の１０７２億元、調整後純利益は５７％減の４９億元だった。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の５２億元を下回った。中国自動車市場の低迷や部品コストの上昇が響いた。海外展開の強化に向け、２７年後半にドイツの自動車市場に参入する計画も明らかにした。

シャオミの新エネルギー車（ＮＥＶ）、人工知能（ＡＩ）などの新規事業は営業損益が３４億元の赤字。ＮＥＶ事業の売上高は１９．９％減の２２７億元。車両納入台数は７．２％減の１０万９７５台だった。

シャオミは業界データを基に、７─９月期の中国の乗用車市場全体の小売販売は２４％減だったと説明。決算発表後の電話会議で、国内自動車市場の低迷は「全ての企業に大きな圧力」になっていると指摘した。コスト高や在庫増も課題となっているとも強調した。アナリストらは、シャオミの自動車事業は価格競争の激化や中国内自動車市場の低迷にさらされていると指摘している。

スマホの売上高は０．８％減。メモリーの調達コストが高止まりし粗利益率が低下。製品構成を高価格帯のモデルにシフトし、スマホの平均販売価格は前四半期から１０％上昇したという。

シャオミは、ＡＩや自社開発半導体、ロボット分野に関する投資を継続すると説明している。

item.title: EXCLUSIVE-マイクロソフトが「コードレッド」宣言、大規模障害受け対応見直し
item.description:
Jaspreet Singh
[２４日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトは今月発生した同社サービスの世界的な大規模障害...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
EXCLUSIVE-マイクロソフトが「コードレッド」宣言、大規模障害受け対応見直し 2:14 配信

11月13日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration（ロイター） Jaspreet Singh

[２４日 ロイター] - 米マイクロソフトは今月発生した同社サービスの世界的な大規模障害を受け、障害の防止および危機対応体制を全面的に見直す「コードレッド（最も深刻かつ緊急性の高いアラート）」を宣言した。ロイターが入手した社内メモで明らかになった。

マイクロソフトは、今後障害が発生した場合、１時間以内の全世界復旧を目指すことを目標とする。エンジニアがシステムの健全性データをより迅速に診断できるよう、ＡＩエージェントを導入する計画だ。

マイクロソフトを巡っては今月、「チームズ」や「アウトルック」などを含む業務ソフト「マイクロソフト３６５」のサービスが約２４時間にわたり停止。世界の企業や政府機関の業務に大きな影響が及び、エンジニアリングシステムや危機対応体制の不備が露呈した。

Ｍ３６５ Coreのジェイソン・ヘンダーソン社長は２０日、社内メモで、クラウド型メールサービス「エクスチェンジ・オンライン」において、これほど多くの顧客がこれほど長期間にわたりメールを利用できなくなった事例はかつてなかったと指摘。「コードレッドとは、われわれのチームにとって最優先の業務であることを意味する」と説明した。

同社の広報担当者は、問題発生時の迅速な解決だけでなく、将来的なサービス中断を防ぐために可能な限りの措置を講じることにコミットしていると強調。「サービスが復旧したからといって、われわれの仕事が終わったわけではない。各チームは得られた教訓を迅速に反映させ、経営陣はこれを最優先事項として徹底する」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 コラム：安全資産性薄まる金　リスクオフでも買われず アングル：マイクロソフト、一時撤退検討の中国市場に踏みとどまった理由 アングル：スペースＸの宇宙データセンター、ＭＳ「海中」計画中止が示す高いハードル 11/25(水) 2:14 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: フアン氏、エヌビディア社員に謝罪 ＣＥＯ復帰後の買い一服で株価約6％安
item.description:
Deborah Mary Sophia Shashwat Chauhan
[２４日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
フアン氏、エヌビディア社員に謝罪　ＣＥＯ復帰後の買い一服で株価約6％安 1:13 配信

2026年11月23日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）。 REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） Deborah Mary Sophia　Shashwat Chauhan

[２４日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手エヌビディアの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に復帰したジェンスン・フアン氏は２４日、カリフォルニア州サンタクララの本社で開かれた全社員集会で、自身が同社の行動規範の一部に違反し、「いくつかのひどい過ち」を犯したと語った。関係者がロイターに明らかにした。

関係者によると、フアン氏は約１時間にわたる集会で従業員に謝罪するとともに、トランプ大統領がエヌビディア取締役会に圧力をかけて自身の復帰を実現させたというのは事実ではないと述べた。

また、行動規範の一部に違反したことは容認できない行為だったと認め、セラピーを受けていることを明らかにした。

さらに、米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズによると、フアン氏は自身が高圧的な上司だったとする報道に異議を唱えたほか、自らが「法を超越した存在」だから復帰できたとする見方も否定した。

２４日の取引で、エヌビディア株は急落し、約５．９％安で終了。フアン氏のＣＥＯへの電撃復帰を受けた前日の急騰の勢いは早くも失われ、投資家の関心は同社の政治面や企業統治面のリスクに向かった。２３日には３１．５％急騰し、時価総額は９５２０億ドル余り拡大していた。２３日に上昇していた他の人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株も値下がりした。

テロス・ウェルス・アドバイザーズのポートフォリオ運用責任者、ダン・シーハン氏は「復帰そのものが、疑問を解消するのと同じくらい新たな疑問を生んでいる。同氏の復帰で大きな不確実性は取り除かれたが、エヌビディアの企業統治がどう評価されるかという懸念は残る」と指摘。「今後、政府がエヌビディアにどの程度関与するのかという疑問もある。また、復帰という判断が暗に示した姿勢を踏まえると、社内の行動規範をどう管理するかも問われる。株価が急騰しても、こうした問題は解決しない」と語った。

エヌビディアは２３日、トランプ大統領の圧力を受け、不倫問題の発覚で辞任したフアン氏を復帰させた。一連の急展開は市場を揺さぶり、同社の技術や資金に依存するＡＩ関連業界にも動揺が広がった。

米議会では与野党の議員がエヌビディアの決定を厳しく批判し、フアン氏の復帰を巡る経緯を議会が精査すべきだと訴えた。

＜続く調査＞

フアン氏とエヌビディアはともに、米連邦捜査局（ＦＢＩ）、司法省、証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）など、州・連邦当局による多数の捜査や審査の対象となっている。

１２月３日には上院の公開公聴会が予定され、フアン氏が証言する見通し。外国の情報機関による活動の可能性や国家安全保障、輸出管理を巡る取締役会独自の調査も続いている。

アンダーセン・キャピタル・マネジメントの創業者、ピーター・アンダーセン氏は「騒ぎが落ち着き始め、人々は（エヌビディアの）決定をより批判的に検討するようになっている。取締役会は自らの決定によって、倫理面と法的な面で極めて大きなリスクを背負った」と述べた。フアン氏による今後の証言も「同社にとって極めて大きなリスク」だと指摘した。

２３日の急騰により、エヌビディアは世界の時価総額ランキングでアップルに次ぐ２位に返り咲いた。ただ、株価はなお１０月６日に付けた過去最高値を約３１％下回っている。

半導体やデータセンター関連銘柄を含むＡＩ関連企業の株価も大幅に上昇し、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種指数の構成銘柄の時価総額は２兆８０００億ドル余り増加した。

テロスのシーハン氏は「２３日の動きは驚きだったが、危機を脱した兆候とは受け止めていない。１つのニュースで時価総額が３兆ドル増える市場は、別のニュースで同じように急落する可能性がある」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 コラム：安全資産性薄まる金　リスクオフでも買われず コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 アングル：世界市場が当面向き合う6つのリスク、地政学や金融政策・ＡＩなど アングル：湾岸諸国、インフラ整備に重点投資　ホルムズ海峡封鎖で紛争耐性強化へ 11/25(水) 6:49 最終更新 ロイター

Exclusive-Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after historic outage, internal memos show

Microsoft Windows app icon in this illustration taken on November 13, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

FAST

Nov 24 : Microsoft has declared a "Code Red" drive to overhaul how it prevents and responds to major service failures after a 24-hour outage exposed shortcomings in its engineering systems and crisis response, according to internal memos reviewed by Reuters. The November 12-13 outage hit governments from Australia and Japan to the United States, delayed trading firms and disrupted airline communications, fueling broader concerns about the vulnerability of critical digital infrastructure. Microsoft said the incident was not related to cyber activity or AI agents. Microsoft blamed the outage on an undetected Windows scalability defect introduced in July. CEO Satya Nadella publicly apologized for the disruption. The Code Red signified the most severe and urgent alert to address weaknesses in Microsoft's engineering and operational practices after the outage disrupted Exchange Online, its cloud-based email service, as well as Outlook, Teams, its Copilot AI assistant and other Microsoft 365 products.

It was the most customer-impacting incident in the history of Exchange Online, M365 Core President Jason Henderson said in a memo to staff on Friday. Never before had so many customers been without email for so long, he said. "Code Red means that this is the highest priority work for our team," Henderson added. 'FOG OF WAR' Amanda Silver, Microsoft's corporate vice president overseeing M365 Core and Work IQ, the company's workplace intelligence platform for AI agents, said in a separate memo on Monday that engineers had to work through a "fog of war" as the outage unfolded. Despite deploying top engineering personnel, responders exchanged more than 11,000 messages across 11 Teams chats and struggled to maintain a cohesive picture of hypotheses and decisions because diagnostic data was scattered across fragmented internal tracking systems, Silver said. Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's executive vice president of Copilot, Agents and Platform, told a Code Red review that the affected component had experienced "roughly ten years' worth of acceptable failures," according to Silver's memo. "Our work doesn't end when service is restored. Our teams keep working around the clock to quickly implement any lessons learned, and our leadership makes sure this is our top priority," a company spokesperson told Reuters when contacted about the memos. RECOVERY TARGET As part of the Code Red, a high-priority mobilization reserved for critical crises, Silver outlined five workstreams focused on load shedding, geographic traffic partitioning and faster recovery mechanisms. Microsoft set a target of achieving worldwide resolution within an hour during future incidents and plans to deploy AI agents to help engineers diagnose system health data more quickly. Henderson said he would hold daily meetings with the Substrate leadership team, which oversees the engineering group responsible for underlying Microsoft 365 services, to track actions stemming from the outage, along with weekly reviews. The company spokesperson said Microsoft is committed not only to resolving issues when they occur, but to doing everything possible to prevent future disruptions. SLOW PATCH DEPLOYMENTS "Unfortunately, all the work we have done over the years was not sufficient to protect us on Thursday," Henderson said, adding that he had conducted an extensive review of the broader organizational and structural issues that allowed the failures to occur. In another memo earlier this month reviewed by Reuters, Henderson said "urgent patches to our M365 Core services" took too long to deploy worldwide. "In a separate recent incident, an urgent production fix took five to six days to reach worldwide saturation. For our most urgent security issues, we need to get from detection to safe worldwide deployment in an hour. Needless to say, we aren't here yet," he wrote.

Source: Reuters

US lawmakers raise alarm at FAA decision to deploy aviation AI tool nationally

A view of the control tower at Newark Liberty International Airport in Newark, New Jersey, US, November 14, 2026. REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

Administrator of the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) Bryan Bedford speaks during the "Red, Flight & Blue: The Future of U.S. Aviation," forum at The Hay-Adams hotel, near The White House, in Washington, DC, US, November 18, 2026. REUTERS/Nathan Howard/File Photo

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 24 : A group of two dozen House Democrats on Tuesday raised serious concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration decision to deploy a new AI tool to assist air traffic controllers nationwide on November 10, days before a major system failure. The FAA in September began using a new software-based AI tool system in the Washington area that uses predictive analytics to improve how flights are managed after awarding an $875 million, 12-year contract to Air Space Intelligence. The Democrats, led by Representative Rick Larsen of Washington, the ranking member of the House Transportation Committee, criticized the "sudden expansion of a largely untested system" and asked the FAA to answer a series of questions by November 30. "We have yet to receive any substantive information proving the system was properly validated before its nationwide expansion," the lawmakers wrote. The system, dubbed Strategic Management of Airspace, Routes, and Trajectories, or SMART, uses data to analyze airline schedules, weather, airport capacity, airspace conditions and operational constraints to predict traffic flows and identify potential conflicts before they occur.

The letter cited the nearly five-hour November 13 nationwide ground stop that led flights to be canceled for an estimated 1.5 million passengers due to an FAA telecom issue. "The federal government is dealing with a crisis of confidence," the letter said. "Americans’ faith in the aviation system is shaken. The opacity and inconsistency with which the FAA has handled the SMART rollout threatens to further undermine that trust." The lawmakers want to know the data used by the FAA to validate SMART operations and what redundancies are in place to "ensure reliable ATC operations in the event of issues or outages impacting SMART." The lawmakers also cited reports that the FAA may have retaliated against employees who raised safety concerns about SMART’s rapid deployment. The FAA declined comment and said it would respond directly to the lawmakers. US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy has called the tool essentially "dumb AI" and emphasized controllers remain in charge, not the software. The system uses over 200 data streams, creates data visualizations, and produces scheduling recommendations for operations experts to consider passing along but does not involve active management of planes in the sky.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＥＣＢ12月利上げの公算、その後の道筋不透明＝オランダ中銀総裁
item.description: [アムステルダム ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのスレイペン・オランダ中銀総裁は２４日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ12月利上げの公算、その後の道筋不透明＝オランダ中銀総裁 0:59 配信

写真はスレイペン・オランダ中銀総裁。3月24日、アムステルダムで撮影。REUTERS/Piroschka van de Wouw（ロイター） [アムステルダム ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのスレイペン・オランダ中銀総裁は２４日、ＥＣＢは１２月の理事会で利上げに踏み切る公算が大きいが、その後の道筋は不透明であるとの見方を示した。

スレイペン氏はアムステルダムで記者団に対し、「われわれは理事会ごとに判断を下す方法を取っているため、次回１２月の理事会で決定することになる。ただ、方向性は明確だと思う」と述べた。

ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）のナーゲル総裁を含む多くのＥＣＢ政策担当者は、ユーロ圏のインフレ率が高すぎるため、ＥＣＢは来月に金融引き締めを迫られる公算が大きいと述べている。

さらに同氏は、多くの不確実性があり次に何が起こるかを見通すことが難しいため、２０２７年の金融政策の見通しについては言及を避けた。そうした不確実性には、フランスなどの国における債務コストの上昇に関連するリスクも含まれると述べた。

スレイペン氏は、市場の懸念を和らげるため、フランス政府に対し、外部からの支援を期待するのではなく、自ら財政改善に向けた措置を講じるよう促し、「フランスの財政問題は、まずフランス自身で解決する必要がある」と指摘。「大半のエコノミストは、その解決には痛みが伴うと言うだろうが、解決は確実に可能だ」と述べた。

item.title: アンソロピック一時12％安、公募価格割れ 時価総額2000億ドル減の勢い
item.description:
Medha Singh
[２４日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックが２４日の取引で一時１２％強...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック一時12％安、公募価格割れ　時価総額2000億ドル減の勢い 0:47 配信

米ニューヨークのタイムズスクエアに掲げられたアンソロピックの看板。11月19日撮影。REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton（ロイター） Medha Singh

[２４日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックが２４日の取引で一時１２％強下落し、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格を下回った。時価総額約２０００億ドルを消失する勢いとなっており、ＡＩ企業の高騰した評価額やコンピューティングインフラに投じられている巨額資金への懸念が強まる可能性がある。

株価は一時１２．６％安の７６．６０ドルと、ＩＰＯ価格の８３ドルを下回った。

アンソロピックは１９日、ナスダック市場に新規上場した。主要ＡＩ開発企業としては世界初の上場で、ＡＩブームの持続性を占う試金石として市場の注目を集めた。初値はＩＰＯ価格を約３４％上回る１１１．５０ドル。その後は１７％高で初日の取引を終えた。ただ、その後はハイテク株全般の売りに押され、下落基調となっている。

２３日は、半導体大手エヌビディアがジェンスン・フアン氏を最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）に復帰させたことが好感され、米株式市場はＡＩ関連株主導で急反発した。しかし、アンソロピックはその上昇相場に乗ることができず、下落して取引を終えた。

ストーンＸのシニアマーケットアナリスト、フィオナ・シンコッタ氏は「データセンター投資の拡大ペースに鈍化が見られれば、アンソロピックの開発スピードに影響を及ぼすことは明らかで、いずれは将来の収益や企業価値にも影響が及ぶだろう」と述べた。

ＩＰＯ後に公募価格を下回ったハイテク関連大手はアンソロピックだけではない。６月に上場した宇宙開発企業スペースＸ は約１カ月後にＩＰＯ価格を下回ったほか、２０１２年にはフェイスブック（現メタ)が上場２日目に公募価格を割り込んだ。

ただ、指数算出会社ＭＳＣＩは１１月３０日の取引終了後、アンソロピック株をグローバル・スタンダード指数に組み入れる予定で、株価の支援材料となる可能性がある。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：中国ユニツリー、上場後に株価急落　バブルやＩＰＯ制度に懸念 焦点：ＳＨＥＩＮの香港上場、ＥＳＧ問題がなお影　投資家の懸念根強く アングル：スペースＸ株が公開価格割れ、投資家の信頼守れるか　他案件に影響も アングル：スペースＸ株取引、上場1週目から熱狂的　個人投資家が殺到 アングル：ＡＩブームを巡る「熱狂」と「不安」　株高騰の一方で大量失業懸念も 11/25(水) 2:47 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang said he violated code of conduct, source says
item.description: Addressing staff at a meeting at Nvidia's headquarters in California, CEO Jensen Huang said it was untrue that he was reinstated because of pressure from US President Donald Trump on the board.
item.dc:creator: CNA

Nvidia's Jensen Huang said he violated code of conduct, source says

Addressing staff at a meeting at Nvidia's headquarters in California, CEO Jensen Huang said it was untrue that he was reinstated because of pressure from US President Donald Trump on the board.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang speaks at Dreamforce 2026 summit in San Francisco on Sep 15, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Carlos Barria)

FAST

Nvidia's reinstated CEO Jensen Huang told employees on Tuesday (Nov 24) that he had violated some of the company's code of conduct and made "some terrible mistakes", one person familiar with the matter told Reuters. Addressing staff at an hour-long all-hands meeting at Nvidia's headquarters in Santa Clara, California - a day after he returned as head of the company he co-founded three decades ago - Huang said it was untrue that he had been reinstated because of pressure from US President Donald Trump on the board, the person said. Huang said he was in therapy and acknowledged it was not acceptable to have violated aspects of Nvidia's code of conduct, the person said. Nvidia's shares closed 5.9 per cent lower as the historic rally sparked on Monday by Huang's reinstatement lost steam, with investors refocusing on the political and governance risks surrounding his return.

His resignation last week over revelations of extramarital affairs , one with an alleged Chinese spy, roiled markets and unsettled the AI ecosystem reliant on the chipmaker's technology and funding. Trump took credit forbringing back Huang. Huang apologised while disagreeing with reports that he had been an abusive boss, the New York Times reported, citing a livestream of the meeting it had reviewed. Huang also rejected claims that he returned because he was a "tech bro" and "above the law", and said he returned because Nvidia's board had evaluated facts and was assured that there was no threat to national security, NYT and Bloomberg News reported. Nvidia said in a statement on Monday that based on US government input, the board was confident that "Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk", a claim backed by Trump in an interview with CNBC.

Related:

Commentary: Jensen Huang should never have been too big to fail at Nvidia

Jensen Huang’s stunning return as Nvidia CEO: A timeline of events

US lawmakers from both parties sharply criticised Nvidia's decision, saying Congress should scrutinise the circumstances surrounding Huang's return. "The reinstatement itself raises as many questions as it answers. His return removes a major uncertainty, but what it leaves behind is an overhang on how Nvidia's governance is viewed," said Dan Sheehan, director of portfolio management at Telos Wealth Advisors. "There are also questions ... about how involved the government will be in Nvidia, and about governance of conduct internally given the stance the reinstatement implicitly took. Those don't get resolved by a soaring stock price." In an interview with the New York Post, Trump said that he's willing to pardon Huang if necessary but that he believes the reinstalled Nvidia CEO should be fine without one. Trump also told the New York Post that Nvidia's success was essential to the US retaining an edge in AI and that he's even open to the company giving the American government an equity stake, noting Intel handed more than 10 per cent of its stake last year. "I thought about it. I said, 'You know, maybe I should do it,' but I didn't bring it up at this point. It's probably not too late," Trump told the New York Post.

Related:

Jensen Huang is back, but questions facing Nvidia remain, say analysts

Nvidia board's Huang reversal raises doubts about independence, critics say

Nvidia and the White House could not immediately be reached for comment outside regular business hours. UNDER THE SCANNER Both Huang and Nvidia are facing a host of state and federal probes and reviews, including from the FBI, the Justice Department and the US Securities and Exchange Commission. A public Senate hearing is set for Dec 3, where Huang is due to testify, while the board's own investigations into potential foreign intelligence efforts, national security and export controls are still underway. "Now that the dust is beginning to settle, people are taking a more critical look at (Nvidia's) decision ... They (board) put themselves at a tremendous ethical and legal risk by the decision they made," said Peter Andersen, founder of Andersen Capital Management. Huang's upcoming testimony is also an "enormous risk to the company", he said. The surge on Monday propelled Nvidia back into second place among the world's most valuable companies, behind Apple, although the stock remains almost 31 per cent below its Oct 6 record high. AI-related companies, including chipmakers and data-center stocks, rose sharply as well, while the benchmark S&P 500 added more than US$2.8 trillion in market value. "As incredible as Monday was, I don't take it as a sign we're out of the woods ... a market that can rise US$3 trillion on one headline can fall just as fast on another," Telos' Sheehan said.

Source: Reuters/lk

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 24 : The dollar slipped on Tuesday, giving back much of Monday's gains, as a sharp rally in AI stocks sparked by Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO faded, and traders questioned whether the greenback had climbed too far, too fast. The US currency has been supported by bets that the Federal Reserve will keep raising interest rates, since growth remains strong and inflation is still stubbornly above the Fed's 2 per cent target. Still, "the US growth edge over the euro zone, UK, and Japan narrowed further in November," which could weigh on the dollar, said Elias Haddad, global head of markets strategy at Brown Brothers Harriman. Fed funds futures traders are pricing in 97 per cent odds of a Fed hike in December, and a 66 per cent chance of an additional increase in January, according to the CME Group's FedWatch Tool.

Huang's reinstatement on Monday gave equities some relief, but some analysts are questioning how long it will last.  Recent stock market wobbles have raised questions about how far the Fed can tighten without hurting the economy. The AI trade has lifted the dollar by drawing capital into the US and raising growth expectations. The dollar also tends to act as a safe haven when stocks fall. The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies including the yen and the euro, fell 0.47 per cent to 103.81, with the euro up 0.6 per cent at $1.0966. US data on Tuesday showed that consumer confidence increased more than expected in November, touching its highest level in nearly two years, amid optimism over labor market conditions and the overall economy following this month's midterm elections.  The single currency was also boosted by data showing that German business morale rose for a seventh straight month in November. The Japanese yen weakened 0.16 per cent against the greenback to 159.24 per dollar. Sterling strengthened 0.64 per cent to $1.3112. The Australian dollar  gained 0.24 per cent to $0.6641, but remained near 11-month lows. In the last month, it has been the worst-performing major currency against the dollar, with a drop of more than 5 per cent as traders price in the prospect of rate cuts. Analysts at JPMorgan said short positions in the Aussie dollar have "accumulated substantially," with bearish positioning reaching "extreme levels in some cases" by their metrics. Weekly data from the US markets regulator shows speculators hold their largest bearish position in the Aussie on record, worth some $12.25 billion, according to LSEG calculations. "Looking first at options, AUD puts have been outnumbering calls for several months now. Early in this process, it seemed reasonable to assume that this might simply be macro hedging, rather than actual outright directional positioning. But the flows have probably migrated to the latter of late," JPMorgan said.  In cryptocurrencies, bitcoin fell 2.40 per cent to $59,824.  (Additional reporting by Amanda Cooper and Rae Wee, editing by Deepa Babington and Cynthia Osterman)

Source: Reuters

(Fixes dropped numeral in second bullet point, 13.1 billion rather than 3.1 billion) By Will Dunham WASHINGTON, Nov 24 : A quasar, one of the universe's most energetic and luminous objects, is the enormously bright core of a galaxy, powered by a central supermassive black hole. Astronomers have now found the oldest-known quasar, one that formed so early in cosmic history that they are still trying to decipher how it happened. They identified a quasar dating to more than 13.1 billion years ago when the cosmos was less than 5 per cent of its current age, some 630 million years after the Big Bang event that initiated the universe. The quasar dates to 40 million years earlier than the previous record holder, disclosed in July.

"I think it adds to the evidence that some objects in the early universe developed remarkably quickly. Just 630 million years after the Big Bang, this black hole had already grown to about 360 million times the mass of the sun and was shining as a quasar," said astronomer Julien Wolf of the European Southern Observatory in Germany, lead author of the research published in the journal Astronomy and Astrophysics. Black holes are extraordinarily dense objects with gravity so strong that not even light can escape. The quasar was first detected by the European Space Agency's Euclid orbiting telescope and then further characterized using a combination of ground- and space-based telescopes.  The researchers gave the quasar the nickname Dún Aonghasa, the name of an ancient stone fort in Ireland that is perched atop a cliff overlooking the vast expanse of the Atlantic Ocean. A supermassive black hole that powers a quasar is typically billions of times more massive than the sun.  "As enormous amounts of gas, dust and matter fall toward the black hole, they form a swirling accretion disk that heats up to extreme temperatures and radiates tremendous amounts of energy, outshining the entire rest of the galaxy by factors of hundreds or even thousands," said astronomer and study co-author Silvia Belladitta of the Max Planck Institute for Astronomy in Germany and the INAF Bologna Observatory of Astrophysics and Space Science in Italy. "This makes quasars visible across billions of light-years, allowing us to observe them from the very early universe. Studying quasars helps astronomers understand how the first galaxies formed and evolved, and how the supermassive black holes at their hearts grew to such enormous sizes," Belladitta said. The Dún Aonghasa supermassive black hole is about 90 times more massive than the one at the center of our Milky Way. A TRANSFORMATIVE EPOCH It dates to one of the universe's most dramatic and transformative epochs. After the Big Bang, the cosmos cooled into a dark and neutral fog of hydrogen gas. The first stars and galaxies then began to ignite, and their intense radiation slowly burned through the fog, making the universe transparent to light for the first time. "This process was still unfolding at the time this quasar and its host galaxy were forming. It is a remarkable epoch to find such an object. The supermassive black hole powering this quasar had already grown to an enormous mass in an extremely short time, which challenges our understanding of how black holes can grow so large so quickly in the early universe," Belladitta said. One possibility is that this black hole started out small after the demise of a star that was part of the first stellar generation, but the observations indicated it was consuming material at a rate too slow to have achieved its great mass so quickly. Another possibility is that it may have been born big in a formation scenario called direct collapse.  "Normally, a large cloud of gas cools and breaks up into smaller clumps that form stars. Under the right conditions, the gas could stay warm enough to limit that fragmentation, allowing much of it to flow towards the center. That gas can build up a single enormous star that quickly collapses into a black hole. That black hole would start out far more massive than the remnant of a typical first-generation star," Wolf said. The researchers said Euclid may yet spot quasars at farther distances — meaning older — than Dún Aonghasa, with theoretical models suggesting that the first quasars could potentially date to 270 million to 470 million years post-Big Bang. "So in short: this is the furthest quasar we have ever seen, but maybe not the furthest there is to find," Belladitta said.

Source: Reuters

Nov 24 : Shares of Hewlett Packard Enterprise fell about 16 per cent on Tuesday as investors focused on the company's shrinking margins amid soaring costs, even as strong AI demand boosted its full-year revenue outlook. The stock has more than doubled this year through Monday's close, but is set to lose about $10 billion in market value if current losses hold. On Monday, HPE soared more than 17 per cent as an Nvidia-fueled rally lifted AI stocks. HPE forecast adjusted operating margin for the fiscal year ending October 2027 between 14 per cent and 15 per cent, from 15.1 per cent in fiscal 2026. At its Cloud and AI unit, which includes servers and storage and is a key growth driver, HPE expects annual fiscal margin of about 14 per cent, down from 15.2 per cent in the previous fiscal. HPE finance chief Marie Myers said on an earnings call that costs were rising faster than pricing and margins would take a hit in the second half of the year as the company ships more AI servers.

"When input costs go up and you don't pass enough of that along, you have to hit your margins and that clearly showed," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B Riley Wealth. "That raises concerns that the pricing tailwinds are beginning to fade. With supply shortages expected through 2028, that will take a bite out of margins," he added. However, robust demand for AI servers demand helped drive a 50 per cent jump in HPE's fourth-quarter revenue to $14.55 billion, topping estimates. The company now expects fiscal 2027 revenue growth between 27 per cent and 35 per cent, up from its earlier forecast of 13 per cent to 17 per cent. "The market seems to be acutely sensitive to any potential changes in profit margins when it comes to tech companies these days," said Bob O'Donnell, chief analyst at TECHnalysis Research. "HPE's solid numbers and robust forecast certainly don't seem to justify today's market's reaction."

Nov 24 : Spotify was back online on Tuesday after the music streaming service was down briefly for thousands of US users earlier in the day, according to outage tracking website Downdetector.com. User reports peaked at more than 14,000 at around 6:45 a.m. ET, according to Downdetector, which tracks outages by collating status reports from a number of sources. Reports had fallen sharply to about 600 as of 7:17 a.m. ET. Downdetector's numbers are based on user-submitted reports. The actual number of affected users may vary. Spotify said on X it was aware of "some issues" and was looking into it, and later added, "Everything's looking much better now."

A string of technology failures this month disrupted critical US systems, including a nationwide halt to air travel, a Microsoft outage that hit email services, a technical glitch that affected several major banks and a temporary disruption to the National Security Agency's network.

FAST

Nov 24 : Best Buy raised its annual comparable sales growth target on Tuesday, betting on robust demand during the holiday shopping season as customers spend on new AI-enabled phones and TVs as well as wearable technology such as smart glasses. "We're seeing the emerging categories bucket ... health rings, AI glasses, and trading cards and collectibles are driving about a full point of comp (comparable sales growth) for us," CEO Jason Bonfig told Reuters. Affluent consumers have been splurging on pricier nice-to-have products across categories from dual-screen phones to Coach handbags, as they lock in gains from stock market portfolios and investments in assets such as real estate. In contrast, lower- and middle-income consumers have sharply pulled back spending, with inflation and high gas prices crimping budgets, exacerbating a K-shaped effect among US consumers this year.

Consumers have also been upgrading their phones, laptops and other gadgets for AI-enabled options, often at higher price points, driving an upgrade cycle for the electronics retailer. Best Buy said it saw "significant strength" in its business above the $1,500 price point in the three months through October, when total comparable sales jumped 6.1 per cent and handily beat estimates of 2.3 per cent growth. The company was working within its supply chain to dull the hit from higher fuel costs, said Bonfig, who took over as CEO earlier this month. Retailers across the board have warned of higher freight costs this year as the US war on Iran drags up oil prices. Best Buy now expects annual comparable sales to rise between 3.4 per cent and 4 per cent, compared with its earlier target of 1.9 per cent to 3 per cent growth. Its stock rose about 2 per cent in morning trading. Comparable sales growth driven by computing and phones is a positive sign for electronics at Walmart, Target and Costco heading into the holiday shopping season, said Stifel analyst Michael Montani. Higher memory chip costs have driven up product prices, but computing demand remained resilient, Best Buy executives said on a post-earnings call. Trade-ins on older products, credit card financing options and some promotions were levers Best Buy was pulling to support sales in the category, executives added. Best Buy's total revenue rose 5.8 per cent to $10.24 billion in the third quarter, beating estimates of $9.90 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. As customers prepared for the launch of "Grand Theft Auto VI", the much-awaited installment in Take-Two Interactive's flagship franchise, Best Buy saw growth in gaming hardware and accessories in the third quarter, Bonfig said. The company raised its fiscal 2027 adjusted earnings per share target to between $6.90 and $7.05, after quarterly adjusted earnings of $1.62 per share topped estimates.

Source: Reuters

item.description: WASHINGTON, Nov 24 : Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh has called artificial intelligence a "hinge" of history critical to US leadership, but the technology has also become key to Fed policy as officials debate whether the AI boom is a transformational moment, a source of inflation, or the harbinger of an economi

AI boom looms over Warsh's Fed as inflation worries grow

FILE PHOTO: US Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh speaks at a press conference, following a two-day meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), at the Federal Reserve in Washington, DC, US, October 28, 2026. REUTERS/Kylie Cooper/File Photo

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 24 : Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh has called artificial intelligence a "hinge" of history critical to US leadership, but the technology has also become key to Fed policy as officials debate whether the AI boom is a transformational moment, a source of inflation, or the harbinger of an economic meltdown.  For Warsh, who calls himself "cautiously optimistic" about what he refers to as "super intelligence," as President Donald Trump does, it may be an all-of-the-above dilemma that challenges the US central bank and his leadership of it. "This is a serious test for Warsh," Evercore ISI Vice Chairman Krishna Guha, a former New York Fed official, wrote after major US equity indexes closed last week in correction territory. They were dragged down by nervousness about AI's ability to pay off and by unease over the scandal around AI chip giant Nvidia and the brief ouster of its CEO. Recent inflation and growth data "is too hot and too strong ... But with growth dependent on AI investment and AI consumer net-worth effects, the Fed needs any weakening to remain contained," Guha wrote. "Warsh needs to balance the data with markets that suggest the forward look is cooler, and his desire to assert inflation credibility with his desire not to go down in history as the Fed chair who blew up the AI boom."

After a run that saw a political backlash against AI, a market slump, a major initial public offering, a massive corporate scandal, and a seeming rebound from it all with equity markets again surging, Fed officials are expected to follow through with a quarter-percentage-point rate increase at their December 8-9 meeting. While they do not necessarily aim to — or have any guarantee they can — slow the AI boom, many see it pushing growth beyond potential and see the need to restrain some aspects of investment and demand. "If the investment rate slows way down, then yes, I'd be less concerned that there would be overheating in the economy," Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee told reporters last week, likening the strain AI puts on capacity to trying to get a "pig through the python." But the impact of rate hikes on the economy "doesn't have to be sector by sector," he said. "The Fed has only one tool, which is to tighten rates ... I do think data centers are included in that business investment" and might be influenced by rising borrowing costs. 'VERY TROUBLING SIGN' Some US central bank officials have recently discussed AI. Fed Governor Lisa Cook noted possible financial risks and the likelihood that AI is already eliminating jobs, and Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said AI investment is currently raising inflation, with any productivity benefits still to come. Warsh, who before taking over as Fed chief had cautioned central bankers to avoid taking sides on political issues like climate change, has called success in AI a make-or-break issue for the US.  "We are at a hinge point for the US economy, the United States' role in the world," Warsh said last week at an AI conference he commissioned, held at the San Francisco Fed. "I don't think any of us are impartial to how we want that to come out."  Increasingly, however, Warsh's colleagues see a more nuanced debate and are focused on near-term implications. The volatility has been apparent: Nvidia reversed course and rehired Jensen Huang as its chief executive officer on Monday, and stocks surged back after recent sharp losses. Politically, the country has become more divided, too, about how to balance AI's benefits and risks, the pace of construction, and concerns that the technology is moving too fast without proper oversight. "People are afraid. When the average American hears AI, they hear I'll lose my job, my kids will lose their jobs, my children's mental health, national security, some version of that," former US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo said on a panel with Warsh at his AI conference.  Raimondo, who currently co-chairs a nonprofit trying to ease the AI transition for workers, noted that many ballot initiatives meant to slow data-center construction were approved by voters during the recent US midterm elections. "I think that is a very troubling sign," she said. "When people are afraid they say 'stop.' I think that would be very bad for America and for them. So where I think we have to go from here is to figure out how we address people's legitimate concerns." WARSH 'BROUGHT THIS REVOLT ON HIMSELF' The Fed's role, as Warsh likes to note, is not to pick winners and losers but to guide the credit conditions in which all firms operate, in ways that affect inflation. Fed officials' view of AI investment as a source of inflation has put the Fed at direct odds with Trump, who wants the boom to roll on. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and other administration officials say rising prices are primarily the fault of still-high global oil prices that will fade as energy costs ease.  Warsh, who has defined his chairmanship partly by avoiding guidance on upcoming policy decisions, has acknowledged that AI "hits demand first," with supply and productivity improvements coming later and possibly helping ease inflation down the road. But he has not yet made the same leap as others and has avoided commenting on whether he feels the AI boom and inflation are now running hand in hand, and on how the Fed may need to respond. That question has become a key issue ahead of the next policy meeting, when policymakers are due to update their interest rate projections after a period in which the rhetoric of many of them leaned hawkish even as the election results, stock markets and other dynamics pointed to a possible slowdown. The problem for markets since the midterm elections "has not been just the prospect of an AI slowdown. It's also been that the Fed has seemingly ignored the risks and uncertainty that the post-election period has brought, and thrown caution to the wind," Macquarie analysts wrote recently. "In a way, Warsh has brought this revolt on himself, by not abandoning his own aversion to expressing forward guidance," even as the debate around what he sees as the signature economic issue of the day has become more complex.

Source: Reuters
